items.title: Goldman Sachs opens up $100B Treasury fund to crypto firms
items.summary: Scott Melker discusses how Goldman Sachs (GS) is opening its $100 billion Treasury fund — FTIXX — up to crypto firms, without tokenizing it. "The Daily Wolf with Scott Melker" airs every day at 12:00 p.m. Tune in for your daily dose of all things crypto.

items.title: Goldman board weighs timeline for Solomon to step down as CEO
items.summary: The board of Goldman Sachs has discussed a plan for Solomon to step down as CEO as soon as the end of 2027 or 2028, according to a Wall Street Journal report.

items.title: Goldman Sachs Private Credit Fund Reports Around 2% Q3 Repurchase Rate

items.title: Goldman Sachs (GS) Board Discusses Naming John Waldron Chief Executive
items.summary: The Goldman Sachs Group, Inc. items.title: Goldman Sachs moves $100B Treasury fund onto digital asset rails
items.summary: Goldman Sachs makes its $100 billion Treasury fund available to crypto firms through the Lynq settlement network.

items.title: JPM vs. GS: The Dividend Raiser That Won’t Flinch When Markets Crack
items.summary: JPMorgan built its reputation as the safe megabank, yet one crisis revealed a dividend surprise that upends the conventional wisdom about which Wall Street giant actually protects retiree income when markets turn ugly.
